newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: J.Martins not interested in beer business.
newsitem.headline: J.Martins not interested in beer business.

text.p: Portuguese retailer Estabelecimentos Jeronimo Martins e Filho is limiting its interest in the beverages sector to bottled water and is not interested in the beer market, its Finance Director said.
"The interest of Jeronimo Martins is confined to the water sector, and it is unlikely that it will be extended to beer," Jorge Ponce de Leao said.
"The trend is for the consumption of alcohol to fall progressively (globally), and so the beer sector is not a strategic sector for us," he said on the sidelines of a presentation about the company.
This year Jeronimo Martins invested 15.8 billion escudos in the acquisition of bottled water company Vidago, Melgaco e Pedras Salgadas.
